steps.title: Deliver lza.lock at the repository root
steps.intent: Create the single hand-maintained provenance lock lza.lock at the repository root, exactly as spec Section 5.1: the ten flat scalar keys (schemaVersion, sourceRepository, version, commit, nodeMajor, yarnVersion, partition, homeRegion, controlTowerLandingZoneVersion, controlTowerOuBaselineVersion) with their pinned values. It is the one place a version/commit/partition/Region literal may live; every script, workflow and test reads it through deploy/scripts/common.sh rather than restating a literal (REP-010/REP-014).
steps.acceptance: lza.lock exists at the repository root and contains exactly the ten Section 5.1 keys with their locked scalar values (version v1.16.1, commit 8b43dc6e347b5fc1c477940c7f71ea595fbf19ab, nodeMajor 22, yarnVersion 1.22.22, partition aws-us-gov, homeRegion us-gov-west-1, controlTowerLandingZoneVersion "4.0", controlTowerOuBaselineVersion "5.0").

steps.title: Deliver deploy/scripts/ (common.sh reader + offline validation script)
steps.intent: Deliver deploy/scripts/common.sh as the single lza.lock reader that validates the ten-key invariant and exports the nine lock-derived shell variables, and deploy/scripts/validate-config-offline.sh implementing the eight Section 7.1 offline checks. Adjust every path taken from the example bundle to work at the repository root: REPOSITORY_ROOT resolves to the repo root, vendor/lza and build/ are repo-root relative, and the workflow referenced by check 6 is the delivered .github/workflows/lza-phase0-0_validate-offline.yml (never the example inputs/lza-phase0/... path or an un-prefixed filename). No script restates a version/commit/partition/Region literal.
steps.acceptance: Sourcing deploy/scripts/common.sh from the repository root enforces the ten-key lock invariant and exports LZA_VERSION/LZA_COMMIT/LZA_PARTITION/LZA_HOME_REGION/CT_LANDING_ZONE_VERSION/CT_OU_BASELINE_VERSION equal to the lock; validate-config-offline.sh sources common.sh, references .github/workflows/lza-phase0-0_validate-offline.yml, and contains no inputs/lza-phase0/ path; every deploy/scripts/*.sh carries the strict-mode header and each non-common script sources common.sh.

steps.title: Deliver the six mandatory LZA config files under config/
steps.intent: Deliver exactly the six mandatory LZA desired-state files under config/ (accounts, global, iam, network, organization, security) and nothing else there (REP-001; no customizations-config.yaml). global-config.yaml pins homeRegion, enabledRegions and the landing-zone version consistent with lza.lock; the iam/network extension collections are empty and the central security services (macie, guardduty, securityHub, detective, auditManager) and AWS Config recorder/delivery/aggregation are disabled, matching the credential-free Phase 0 posture.
steps.acceptance: config/ contains exactly the six mandatory files and no customizations-config.yaml; iam/network extension collections are empty and the central security services and AWS Config recorder/delivery/aggregation are disabled; all six parse as YAML.

steps.title: Deliver Control Tower desired-state declarations under control-tower/
steps.intent: Deliver control-tower/landing-zone-manifest.template.json (placeholders only for API-discovered account/key IDs), baselines.yaml, controls.yaml, control-exceptions.yaml (empty exceptions) and ownership-matrix.yaml. The landing-zone version and OU baseline version derive from lza.lock; governed Regions equal homeRegion; every ownership domain has exactly one authoritative owner and the protected domains belong to control-tower (REP-004/REP-005).
steps.acceptance: The Control Tower declarations validate against their schemas and agree with lza.lock: manifest/baselines/controls versions and governed Region match the lock and config; the manifest template carries only the three declared placeholder tokens with explicit enabled flags; every ownership domain has exactly one owner and all protected domains are owned by control-tower.

steps.title: Deliver deployment/ example inputs, example state, and repository JSON Schemas
steps.intent: Deliver deployment/inputs.example.yaml (the one permitted second copy of lza.version/lza.commit, which the consistency test checks against the lock), the example render-map/phase-state/state JSON documents, and the six repository JSON Schemas under deployment/schemas/ (REQ-041: deployment/schemas, never the reserved schemas/). The evidence schema forbids a live-validator claim so the offline gate cannot misreport that the exact LZA validator ran.
steps.acceptance: Every JSON document under deployment/ parses; inputs.example.yaml's lza.version and lza.commit equal the lock's values; and the six schema files exist under deployment/schemas/.

steps.title: Deliver the Bats test suites under tests/
steps.intent: Deliver the offline Bats suites the gate runs (consistency, shell, ownership, controls, control-tower-manifest, config, evidence) directly under the existing repository tests/ directory, alongside the oversight test subdirectories without collision. Each resolves REPOSITORY_ROOT to the repository root and sources deploy/scripts/common.sh; consistency.bats references the delivered workflow filename lza-phase0-0_validate-offline.yml (not the example inputs/lza-phase0/... path).
steps.acceptance: The seven LZA Bats suites are present under tests/, each sources deploy/scripts/common.sh and anchors REPOSITORY_ROOT at the repo root, consistency.bats references lza-phase0-0_validate-offline.yml, and no delivered test contains an inputs/lza-phase0/ path.

steps.title: Deliver root supporting files (Makefile, README.md, CODEOWNERS, .gitignore, .editorconfig, .yamllint.yml)
steps.intent: Deliver the root supporting files the gate and reviewers need: Makefile (validate-offline/test targets), README.md, CODEOWNERS at the repository root requiring review for lza.lock, config/**, control-tower/** and deployment/schemas/** (REP-013; .github/CODEOWNERS is reserved), .editorconfig, .yamllint.yml, and the .gitignore coverage REP-008 requires. The existing repository root .gitignore is extended with the LZA generated paths rather than replaced, so no current oversight ignore entry is lost.
steps.acceptance: CODEOWNERS at the root requires review for lza.lock, config/**, control-tower/** and deployment/schemas/**; the root .gitignore covers the REP-008 LZA generated paths (vendor/, cdk.out/, .aws/, generated evidence, env/token files) while preserving existing entries; Makefile exposes a validate-offline target invoking deploy/scripts/validate-config-offline.sh.

steps.title: Deliver the Phase 0 offline validation workflow (credential-free)
steps.intent: Deliver .github/workflows/lza-phase0-0_validate-offline.yml (REQ-043/REQ-050: <workload-slug>_validate-offline.yml, slug lza-phase0-0). It requests contents: read only — no id-token: write, no environment, no subject-deploy (REQ-049); triggers on push and pull_request each with branches:[main] and the same non-empty root-relative paths filter plus workflow_dispatch (plan_ref, commit); checks out the commit under judgment, checks out and verifies the locked LZA source into vendor/lza, runs deploy/scripts/validate-config-offline.sh, and uploads evidence/digests. Every third-party action is pinned to a 40-character commit SHA (REQ-008).
steps.acceptance: The workflow requests contents: read only with no id-token/environment/subject-deploy; declares push and pull_request each with branches:[main] and a non-empty paths filter plus workflow_dispatch(plan_ref, commit); runs deploy/scripts/validate-config-offline.sh; references only root-relative paths and the delivered filename; and pins every third-party action to a 40-character commit SHA.

verification_targets.check: lza.lock exists at the repository root and contains exactly the ten Section 5.1 keys with their locked scalar values.
verification_targets.run: sh -c 'test -f lza.lock && grep -qx "schemaVersion: 2" lza.lock && grep -qx "sourceRepository: https://github.com/awslabs/landing-zone-accelerator-on-aws.git" lza.lock && grep -qx "version: v1.16.1" lza.lock && grep -qx "commit: 8b43dc6e347b5fc1c477940c7f71ea595fbf19ab" lza.lock && grep -qx "nodeMajor: 22" lza.lock && grep -qx "yarnVersion: 1.22.22" lza.lock && grep -qx "partition: aws-us-gov" lza.lock && grep -qx "homeRegion: us-gov-west-1" lza.lock && grep -qx '"'"'controlTowerLandingZoneVersion: "4.0"'"'"' lza.lock && grep -qx '"'"'controlTowerOuBaselineVersion: "5.0"'"'"' lza.lock'

verification_targets.check: Sourcing deploy/scripts/common.sh from the repo root passes the ten-key lock invariant and exports the lock-derived variables with the locked values.
verification_targets.run: bash -c 'set -e; source deploy/scripts/common.sh; test "$LZA_VERSION" = v1.16.1; test "$LZA_COMMIT" = 8b43dc6e347b5fc1c477940c7f71ea595fbf19ab; test "$LZA_PARTITION" = aws-us-gov; test "$LZA_HOME_REGION" = us-gov-west-1; test "$CT_LANDING_ZONE_VERSION" = 4.0; test "$CT_OU_BASELINE_VERSION" = 5.0'

verification_targets.check: validate-config-offline.sh references the delivered workflow .github/workflows/lza-phase0-0_validate-offline.yml and carries no inputs/lza-phase0/ example path.
Every deploy/scripts/*.sh begins with the strict-mode header and each non-common script sources common.sh.
verification_targets.run: bash -c 'set -e; for f in deploy/scripts/*.sh; do test "$(sed -n 1p "$f")" = "#!/usr/bin/env bash"; test "$(sed -n 2p "$f")" = "set -Eeuo pipefail"; case "$f" in */common.sh) ;; *) grep -qF '"'"'source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/common.sh"'"'"' "$f";; esac; done'

verification_targets.check: config/ holds exactly the six mandatory LZA files and no customizations-config.yaml.
verification_targets.run: bash -c 'test "$(find config -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)" -eq 6; for n in accounts global iam network organization security; do test -f "config/$n-config.yaml"; done; test ! -e config/customizations-config.yaml'

verification_targets.check: IAM/network extension collections are empty and the central security services and AWS Config recorder/delivery/aggregation are disabled in the Phase 0 config.
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import yaml; L=lambda n: yaml.safe_load(open(f"config/{n}-config.yaml")); iam=L("iam"); net=L("network"); sec=L("security"); assert all(iam[k]==[] for k in ("providers","policySets","roleSets","groupSets","userSets")); assert all(net[k]==[] for k in ("transitGateways","vpcs","vpcTemplates","vpcPeering")); assert sec["awsConfig"]["enableConfigurationRecorder"] is False; assert all(sec["centralSecurityServices"][s]["enable"] is False for s in ("macie","guardduty","securityHub","detective","auditManager"))'

verification_targets.check: Control Tower landing-zone version, OU baseline version and governed Region agree across the lock, global-config.yaml, inputs.example.yaml, the manifest template and baselines.yaml.
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import json,yaml; g=yaml.safe_load(open("config/global-config.yaml")); inp=yaml.safe_load(open("deployment/inputs.example.yaml")); b=yaml.safe_load(open("control-tower/baselines.yaml"))["baselines"][0]; m=json.load(open("control-tower/landing-zone-manifest.template.json")); assert g["controlTower"]["landingZone"]["version"]==inp["controlTower"]["landingZoneVersion"]=="4.0"; assert b["version"]==inp["controlTower"]["infrastructureBaselineVersion"]=="5.0"; assert g["homeRegion"]==inp["aws"]["govCloudHomeRegion"]=="us-gov-west-1"; assert g["enabledRegions"]==m["governedRegions"]==inp["controlTower"]["governedRegions"]==["us-gov-west-1"]'

verification_targets.check: Every ownership domain has exactly one authoritative owner and all protected domains belong to control-tower.
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import collections,yaml; m=yaml.safe_load(open("control-tower/ownership-matrix.yaml")); o=collections.defaultdict(list); [o[i["domain"]].append(i["authoritativeOwner"]) for i in m["domains"]]; assert all(len(v)==1 for v in o.values()); prot={"organization-cloudtrail","config-recorders","config-delivery-channels","config-aggregator","managed-service-control-policies","controls","control-tower-service-roles","baseline-resources","control-tower-stacksets"}; assert prot<=set(o); assert all(o[n]==["control-tower"] for n in prot)'

verification_targets.check: The landing-zone manifest template contains only the three declared placeholder tokens and explicit enabled flags.
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import json,re; m=json.load(open("control-tower/landing-zone-manifest.template.json")); t=re.findall(r"\$\{[^}]+\}",json.dumps(m)); assert sorted(set(t))==sorted(("${LOG_ARCHIVE_ACCOUNT_ID}","${AUDIT_ACCOUNT_ID}","${CONTROL_TOWER_KMS_KEY_ARN}")); assert m["accessManagement"]["enabled"] is False and m["backup"]["enabled"] is False; assert all(m[k]["enabled"] is True for k in ("centralizedLogging","config","securityRoles"))'

verification_targets.check: Every JSON document under deployment/ parses and inputs.example.yaml's lza.version/lza.commit equal the lock (the one permitted second copy).
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import json,glob,yaml; [json.load(open(p)) for p in glob.glob("deployment/**/*.json",recursive=True)]; inp=yaml.safe_load(open("deployment/inputs.example.yaml")); assert inp["lza"]["version"]=="v1.16.1"; assert inp["lza"]["commit"]=="8b43dc6e347b5fc1c477940c7f71ea595fbf19ab"'

verification_targets.check: The six repository JSON Schemas are delivered under deployment/schemas/ (never the reserved schemas/).
verification_targets.run: bash -c 'for s in deployment-evidence deployment-state landing-zone-manifest baselines controls ownership-matrix; do test -f "deployment/schemas/$s.schema.json"; done'

verification_targets.check: The seven LZA Bats suites are delivered under tests/, consistency.bats references the delivered workflow filename, and no delivered test carries an inputs/lza-phase0/ path.
verification_targets.run: bash -c 'for f in consistency shell ownership controls control-tower-manifest config evidence; do test -f "tests/$f.bats"; done; grep -qF "lza-phase0-0_validate-offline.yml" tests/consistency.bats && ! grep -RqF "inputs/lza-phase0" tests'

verification_targets.check: Each delivered Bats suite sources deploy/scripts/common.sh so it anchors on the repository root.
verification_targets.run: bash -c 'set -e; for f in tests/consistency.bats tests/shell.bats tests/ownership.bats tests/controls.bats tests/control-tower-manifest.bats tests/config.bats tests/evidence.bats; do grep -qF "deploy/scripts/common.sh" "$f"; done'

verification_targets.check: Root CODEOWNERS requires review for lza.lock, config/**, control-tower/** and deployment/schemas/**.
verification_targets.run: bash -c 'test -f CODEOWNERS && grep -qE "^/lza.lock[[:space:]]" CODEOWNERS && grep -qE "^/config/\*\*[[:space:]]" CODEOWNERS && grep -qE "^/control-tower/\*\*[[:space:]]" CODEOWNERS && grep -qE "^/deployment/schemas/\*\*[[:space:]]" CODEOWNERS'

verification_targets.check: The root .gitignore covers the REP-008 LZA generated paths while preserving existing entries.
verification_targets.run: bash -c 'for p in "vendor/" "cdk.out/" ".aws/" "deployment-evidence.json" ".env" "build/"; do grep -qF "$p" .gitignore; done'

verification_targets.check: Makefile exposes a validate-offline target invoking deploy/scripts/validate-config-offline.sh.
The Phase 0 workflow requests contents: read only, names no environment, and requests no id-token/subject-deploy (REQ-049).
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import re; t=open(".github/workflows/lza-phase0-0_validate-offline.yml").read(); assert "id-token" not in t; assert "subject-deploy" not in t; assert "environment:" not in t; assert re.search(r"permissions:\s*\n\s*contents:\s*read",t)'

verification_targets.check: The workflow declares push and pull_request plus workflow_dispatch(plan_ref, commit), references only root-relative paths and the delivered filename, and runs the offline validation script.
verification_targets.run: bash -c 'f=.github/workflows/lza-phase0-0_validate-offline.yml; grep -qF "lza-phase0-0_validate-offline.yml" "$f" && ! grep -qF "inputs/lza-phase0" "$f" && grep -q "workflow_dispatch" "$f" && grep -q "plan_ref" "$f" && grep -q "commit" "$f" && grep -q "pull_request" "$f" && grep -q "push" "$f" && grep -qF "deploy/scripts/validate-config-offline.sh" "$f"'

verification_targets.check: Every third-party action in the workflow is pinned to a 40-character commit SHA (no @vN/@main/@master tags).

boundary_cases.description: A root .gitignore already exists in this repository (the oversight machinery's). The delivered .gitignore must EXTEND it with the REP-008 LZA generated paths, never overwrite it — no existing ignore entry may be dropped.

The example workflow's pull_request trigger has a paths filter but no branches:[main]. Section 21.9 Guard 2 refuses a pull_request without both branches:[main] and a non-empty paths filter, so the delivered workflow must add branches:[main] and types:[opened,synchronize,reopened] to pull_request.

Renaming the workflow to the slug-prefixed lza-phase0-0_validate-offline.yml must be propagated to every internal reference: check 6 of validate-config-offline.sh (actionlint + yamllint targets), the consistency.bats path list, and the workflow's own paths self-reference. Additionally the concurrency group must be a FULLY LITERAL static value with no ${{ ... }} expressions: Guard D6.2 (scripts/gates/lib/checks-subject-workflow.ts:450) rejects any ${{ ... }} expression in the group even when the literal prefix is correct, so the example's `group: lza-phase0_validate-offline-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}` still fails the guard. Set the concurrency block to exactly `group: lza-phase0_validate-offline` with `cancel-in-progress: false` (per operator correction #80).

tests/ already exists with the oversight subdirectories (fixtures, integration, mocks, unit). The LZA Bats suites land as new files directly under tests/ without collision, and each resolves REPOSITORY_ROOT to the repository root via BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/..

deployment/inputs.example.yaml keeps github.owner/github.repository as REPLACE_ME and govCloudManagementAccountId empty, and the manifest template keeps the three ${...} account/KMS tokens. These stay as the declared placeholder set in Phase 0 (resolved only in later credentialed phases); the placeholder allowlist check counts them exactly.
